title: Deliver Acarat market evidence, valuation, land intelligence, and decision models
outcome: Acarat produces reproducible, explainable, calibrated rent, sale, and land price ranges plus comparable evidence, market position, listing diagnostics, customer matching, and scenario intelligence with abstention under insufficient evidence.
rationale: Program-level intelligence child spanning roadmap P11-P13 and P18. It is explicitly not a model-training authorization.
scope_in: P11 market evidence ingestion and comparable engine
P12 Fair Rent and Fair Sale baseline
P18 intelligence expansion and scenario tools
scope_out: Production ML without held-out calibration evidence
acceptance: Every valuation/model capability is refined into bounded Grains with source rights, leakage prevention, temporal/geographic holdouts, baseline comparison, calibration, segment metrics, artifact identity, rollback, and abstention.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; model deployment is separately gated.
